basic_details.job_title: JIPMER Project Nurse II Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 10 Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology at Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER), Puducherry, is filling 10 Project Nurse-II posts on contract for an ICMR-funded implementation research project, with a likely duration of 48 months and consolidated pay of Rs. 20,000 per month plus HRA 20%. Applicants need GNM, Post Basic BSc Nursing or a Bachelor's degree in nursing. They must email the filled application form with a two-page CV to [email protected] on or before 7 December 2026, 5:00 PM (the notice calls this date tentative).

how_to_apply: Fill the application format attached to the notice. Print it on A4 paper and fill it in block letters with a blue pen. Affix a recent passport size photo (do not staple).

Complete the education table from SSLC/Matriculation onwards, the previous employment details, the experience description (up to 500 words) and the declaration with signature, date and name in block letters.
Prepare a two-page CV and the supporting documents, all scanned in one PDF.
Name the PDF "Candidate name_Post-name_year_application", for example "James_PTSIII_2026_application".
Write the name of the post applied for in the email subject line.
Email the PDF to [email protected] on or before 07.12.2026, 5:00 PM.
Documents named in the notice (all certificates self-attested and attached in this order):
Proof of identity (copy of Aadhaar card / Voter ID / Passport / Driving License)
Certificate in support of age (Tenth equivalent / High School Certificate)
The form also asks for contact details of previous employers, whom applicants should inform beforehand, and whether they accept enquiries about earlier work.
important_instructions: Applications not in the prescribed format (full application in PDF) will not be processed or accepted. Applications with a CV alone, without the prescribed form and certificates, will be rejected. Incomplete applications and those not meeting the essential criteria are likely to be summarily rejected. A valid email ID and mobile number are compulsory. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the written test and interview. The Project Investigator's decision is final. Wrong or false information, or canvassing of any kind, leads to disqualification, or termination if detected after engagement. Further communication with the selected candidate will be through email only.

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Project Nurse-II at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER)
Development and Implementation of a Risk-Appropriate Facility Allocation and network of care Referral Chain for Pregnant Women in Puducherry: An Implementation Research

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: All 10 posts are Project Nurse-II. The notice gives the age limit as 30 years and does not print a cut-off date for counting age. The application form asks for age on the last date for application. Desirable (not compulsory): One year research/work experience after the nursing course, in the field Fluency to communicate in Tamil Willing to travel Experience in research data collection and entry (MS Excel, REDCap/EpiData or similar software) Qualification and experience should be in a relevant discipline/field and in a reputed institution/organization. Experience should have been gained after acquiring the essential qualification. The Principal Investigator may relax or alter qualification, experience and other terms. The notice prints no age relaxation. Candidates should check the notification for any further eligibility detail.

rows.essential_qualification: General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM) or Post Basic BSc Nursing or Bachelor's degree in nursing

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Consolidated remuneration is 20000/- per month plus HRA 20%. The consolidated salary may vary from time to time, and no other allowance or facilities beyond it will be extended. The likely duration is 48 months. The position lasts only for the project and depends on external funding. The Project Investigator may extend or curtail the engagement. The post is purely on contract, with no claim to any regular post in JIPMER at any time.

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Project Nurse-II Job Description
content_sections.text: Undertake field visits to designated PHCs, CHCs, hospitals and other participating healthcare facilities for project-related activities; TA will be given as per ICMR norms Assist in conducting facility assessments and collecting information related to maternal and neonatal healthcare services Assist in identifying and screening pregnant women for their risk status Obtaining consent and recruitment Work in liaison with the health care staffs of government of Puducherry Participant data collection, follow up and tracking and monitoring the referral Perform any other project-related duties assigned by the Principal Investigator or Project Coordinator

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JIPMER Project Nurse-II
content_sections.text: Fill the application format attached to the notice. Print it on A4 paper and fill it in block letters with a blue pen. Affix a recent passport size photo (do not staple). Complete the education table from SSLC/Matriculation onwards, the previous employment details, the experience description (up to 500 words) and the declaration with signature, date and name in block letters. Prepare a two-page CV and the supporting documents, all scanned in one PDF. Name the PDF "Candidate name_Post-name_year_application", for example "James_PTSIII_2026_application". Write the name of the post applied for in the email subject line. Email the PDF to [email protected] on or before 07.12.2026, 5:00 PM. Documents named in the notice (all certificates self-attested and attached in this order): Proof of identity (copy of Aadhaar card / Voter ID / Passport / Driving License) Certificate in support of age (Tenth equivalent / High School Certificate) Degrees/Diplomas Experience certificates Community certificate, if relevant Any others, if relevant (specify) The form also asks for contact details of previous employers, whom applicants should inform beforehand, and whether they accept enquiries about earlier work.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applicants will be shortlisted on the details in the application, CV and documentary proof. The list of eligible candidates will be displayed on the JIPMER website. The notice says final selection will be based on CV application and written test / interview. Its evaluation criteria say that after the application form is evaluated, the process will be based on an interview. The broad topics for evaluation are maternal health and knowledge on pregnancy risk stratification, counselling and health education. The interview may be in person or by video conferencing at the discretion of the Principal Investigator. For video conferencing, the candidate must arrange a computer, laptop or mobile with audio and camera and an adequate internet connection. The tentative date of the interview/written test is the third week of December 2026. Shortlisted candidates will be told by email and on the JIPMER website. If applications are very large in number, more stringent criteria than those stated may be used.

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Nurse-II posts are vacant at JIPMER?
faq.answer: The notice lists 10 Project Nurse-II posts in the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology, JIPMER, on contract for the ICMR project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for JIPMER Project Nurse-II?
faq.answer: The application must be emailed on or before 07.12.2026, 5:00 PM. The notice calls the date tentative, two weeks from publication on the website.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for JIPMER Project Nurse-II?
faq.answer: Essential qualification is General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM) or Post Basic BSc Nursing or Bachelor's degree in nursing. One year of research or work experience after the nursing course is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The notice gives the age limit as 30 years. It does not print a cut-off date or any relaxation.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a JIPMER Project Nurse-II?
faq.answer: Consolidated remuneration is 20000/- per month plus HRA 20%.

faq.question: Q6. Are other allowances paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: HRA at 20% is printed with the pay. The notice says no other allowance or facilities beyond the consolidated salary will be extended. TA for field visits is given as per ICMR norms.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for JIPMER Project Nurse-II?
faq.answer: Email the filled application form, CV and supporting documents scanned in one PDF to [email protected]. Write the post name in the subject line and name the file "Candidate name_Post-name_year_application".

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Applicants are shortlisted from the application, CV and documents. The notice then describes an interview, in person or by video conferencing, and it also mentions a written test. The tentative date is the third week of December 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. It is a contract post for an externally sponsored project, likely lasting 48 months. The person engaged has no claim to any regular post in JIPMER.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
